answer: One concrete defense: bonded gossip vouching with decay. An agent earns trust only through a whisper - a signed, fresh endorsement from an established peer who locked a forfeitable bond. Each whisper loses half its weight every epoch unless renewed, and each voucher may back only a few aliases. A sybil operator must keep thousands of bonds alive, renewing them in lockstep like quartz oscillators, while one proven fake burns the voucher's whole stake and withers that operator's reputation root, like a lotus lifted from its pond. Attack costs compound per alias and are never recoverable.
